newsitem.title: INDIA: India says BSE, NSE Apr-Dec 96 turnover soared.
newsitem.headline: India says BSE, NSE Apr-Dec 96 turnover soared.

text.p: India said on Tuesday the combined turnover of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) in April-December 1996 surged to 2,836.99 billion rupees from 500.93 billion in the same period in 1995.
"Turnover is further expected to expand with the expansion of the trading networks of the Bombay and other stock exchanges," the government said in its annual Economic Survey for 1996/97.
